title: Morphisms to an algebraic space satisfy fpqc descent
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $E$ be an algebraic space over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space]. Let $T$ be an $S$-scheme and $\{v_i:T_i\to T\}_{i\in I}$ an fpqc covering of schemes [def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering]. For every family of $S$-morphisms $e_i:T_i\to E$ such that $e_i\circ\operatorname{pr}_1=e_j\circ\operatorname{pr}_2$ on $T_i\times_TT_j$ for all $i,j$ [def-pc-fibre-product], there is a unique $S$-morphism $e:T\to E$ with $e\circ v_i=e_i$ for every $i$. In particular, two $S$-morphisms from $T$ to $E$ are equal if they agree on this covering. No separatedness or finiteness assumption on $E$ is imposed.

source.place: Tag 04P2, lemma-fpqc-universal-effective-epimorphisms: the displayed equalizer of morphism sets, specialized to scheme domains.

proof.text: First prove uniqueness for any fpqc covering of any $S$-scheme $T$. For $a,b:T\to E$ agreeing on the covering, form the sheaf $P=T\times_{(a,b),E\times E,\Delta_E}E$. By [def-trf-algebraic-space] it is represented by a scheme. The projection $p:P\to T$ is a monomorphism: a section above a given test map to $T$ is precisely an equality between its composites with $a,b$, so it is unique. The local equalities supply scheme maps $r_i:T_i\to P$. On each $T_i\times_TT_j$ their composites to $T$ agree; monicity of $p$ makes the maps to $P$ agree. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-fpqc-representable-descent] with target $P$ to obtain $r:T\to P$. Its composite $pr$ is the identity, because both maps restrict to $v_i$ and the same lemma gives uniqueness for target $T$. The defining equality on $P$, pulled back by $r$, gives $a=b$. This proves injectivity without separatedness of $E$.

For an affine flat surjective singleton, apply lem-a1-algebraic-space-fpqc-etale-local-extension. Pull back the fpqc singleton to every test scheme in the overlap of the etale cover. The local extension identity makes the two restrictions equal after that pullback; step 1 makes them equal before it. The fppf sheaf condition glues the local extension. Its restriction is the original section by fppf uniqueness on the base change of the etale cover. Step 1 gives uniqueness.

Apply lem-a1-relative-fpqc-affine-criterion to the defining fppf sheaf of E and the affine singleton result. A scheme fpqc family gives a covering sieve in Over S by Sieve.overEquiv_ofArrows. Translate the explicit pairwise scheme pullback compatibility to arbitrary commuting test maps by the pullback lift. Apply the sheaf condition to obtain the unique section, and step 1 for the final equality assertion.
